theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcdr_cube_periodic
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), m + 1 < P → ∀ a : Euclid P, (∀ i, |a i - 1 / 2| < 1 / 4) → ∀ κ : (Fin P → ℝ) → ℝ, (∀ u : Fin P → ℝ, ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), P ≤ m + 1 + s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, κ u ≤ u i) → ∀ Φ : Euclid P → Euclid P, (∀ (y : Euclid P) (i : Fin P), Φ y i = a i + (y i - a i) / max (max ((y i - a i) / (1 - a i)) ((a i - y i) / a i)) (κ (fun j => max ((y j - a j) / (1 - a j)) ((a j - y j) / a j)))) → ∀ y y' : Euclid P, (∀ i, 0 ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ 1) → (∀ i, 0 ≤ y' i ∧ y' i ≤ 1) → (∀ i, ∃ k : ℤ, y' i - y i = k) → ∀ i, Φ y' i = Φ y i + (y' i - y i)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
